Title: Azure Search now supports complex search types

Body.Content:
Raw datasets sometimes include hierarchical or nested substructures that do not break down neatly into a tabular rowset, such as multiple locations and phone numbers for a single customer, multiple colors and sizes for a single SKU, and multiple authors of a single book. This is the most requested Azure Search feature and is now natively supported to extend the types of data that can be stored and searched.

Learn more
